inputs.text: The Liberal Party is showing dangerous cracks from within, with some MPs floating leadership changes because Andrew Hastie wants to open the door to higher taxes on gas companies and stripping concessions from property investors. Angus Taylor has rightly slammed the door on those ideas, exposing the real philosophical clash with the opposition leader. The leader at least had the sense not to echo Hastie's attacks on Donald Trump, but his evasion on whether he will back the US and Israel against Iran is worrying. We cannot afford to drift toward bigger government and weak alliances if we are going to defend our traditions, personal responsibility, and national way of life.
